package com.attendance.tracker.data.model;

/**
 * Computed attendance summary for a single subject.
 * Pure data object — all percentage / missable / required calculations
 * are done in the constructor so the UI only reads pre-computed fields.
 */
public class SubjectAttendance {
    private final String subject;
    private final String branch;
    private final String batch;
    private final int totalClasses;
    private final int attended;
    private final int leaves;
    private final double percentage;
    private final int missableClasses;   // how many more can be missed (if ≥ 75%)
    private final int requiredClasses;   // how many must attend to reach 75% (if < 75%)

    public SubjectAttendance(String subject, String branch, String batch,
                             int totalClasses, int attended, int leaves) {
        this.subject = subject;
        this.branch = branch;
        this.batch = batch;
        this.totalClasses = totalClasses;
        this.attended = attended;
        this.leaves = leaves;

        this.percentage = totalClasses > 0 ? ((double) attended / totalClasses) * 100.0 : 0.0;

        if (percentage >= 75.0) {
            this.missableClasses = totalClasses > 0
                    ? (int) Math.floor((attended - 0.75 * totalClasses) / 0.75)
                    : 0;
            this.requiredClasses = 0;
        } else {
            this.requiredClasses = (int) Math.ceil((0.75 * totalClasses - attended) / 0.25);
            this.missableClasses = 0;
        }
    }

    public String getSubject()        { return subject; }
    public String getBranch()         { return branch; }
    public String getBatch()          { return batch; }
    public int getTotalClasses()      { return totalClasses; }
    public int getAttended()          { return attended; }
    public int getLeaves()            { return leaves; }
    public double getPercentage()     { return percentage; }
    public int getMissableClasses()   { return missableClasses; }
    public int getRequiredClasses()   { return requiredClasses; }
}
